proposition: Under the map n -> n/2 when n is even, n -> 3n+1 when n is odd, every integer n with 1 <= n <= 327637 reaches 1 in fewer than 386 steps.
hypotheses: the stopping time counts steps until the value 1 is reached

argument.text: Every n in [1, 50] has stopping time below 386; the smallest values are checked directly.
A direct sweep verifies that every n in [1, 4989] has stopping time below 386.
For every integer n with 2 <= n <= 2000 we have n^2 >= 2n.
There exists an integer n in [1, 2000] with n^2 > 2000.
The sweep covers [1, 4989]; the statement is asserted for every n in [1, 327637].
